text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a pale icy grey, fluid long-sleeve dress with a relaxed elongated tunic top and dropped-waist skirt. The upper body is loose and straight through the torso, with a soft open shirt collar, a deep narrow V/placket exposing the upper chest, slightly sloped shoulders, and long sleeves ending at small buttoned cuffs. The dress falls past the hips before breaking into a low gathered/pleated skirt section, creating a long torso proportion over a fuller lower volume; small dark buttons or tab details sit near the dropped seam at the front. The skirt is midi-to-ankle length with vertical pleats and soft movement, finished with a contrasting deep burgundy band visible along parts of the hem. Styling includes a chunky dark beaded necklace at the base of the neck, a small black hand-carried bag with a chain strap in the model’s right hand, and high platform Mary Jane-style shoes with dark uppers, pale straps, and chunky off-white platform soles/heels. The overall mood is minimal, fluid, and polished, with muted cool color contrasted by burgundy hem accents, black accessories, and sculptural platform footwear.
key_elements: pale icy grey dropped-waist long-sleeve dress
open shirt collar with deep V placket
dark Mary Jane-style platform shoes with off-white soles

Bag surface construction appears compact and dark but fine detailing is unclear.
